{{Top|leg}}
A '''holographic generator''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> also known as a '''Hologram Generator''',<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> was part of the technology used aboard the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' in their adventure rooms. In conjunction with [[tactile array]]s and [[olfactory emitter]]s, holographic generators created realistic simulations of other environments. During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the ''Coral Vanda'' had four adventure rooms, and the technology was used to create simulations of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Imperial Plaza]], the sky [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Tranthellix]], a bazaar on an [[Ithorian Herdship]] and [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest's]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] caverns.<ref name="EGVV" /> The generator was part of [[multispectrum disguise suite]]s such as [[Corellidyne Visuals]]' [[CQ-3.9x holographic image disguiser]].<ref name="EGWT" />
